1110.title: Tibetan Bowl Struck #1
1110.recording: Indoor; Tascam DR-40 and Sennheiser ME66
1110.selection: Ending: lower approximately 305 Hz mode, longest natural decay. Trim the pre-strike room noise and soften the upper resonances.

2553.title: Tibetan bowl struck #2
2553.recording: Studio; Sound Devices MixPre-3 and Sennheiser ME66
2553.selection: Starting: approximately 474 Hz lower mode; gentler measured strike than #3 and less upper-band prominence than #4.

2554.title: Tibetan bowl struck #3
2554.recording: Studio; Sound Devices MixPre-3 and Sennheiser ME66
2554.selection: Interval until 2026-10-15 (replaced by the owner's gong): similar approximately 473 Hz mode to the starting bowl, shorter decay. Retained as a comparison source.

2555.title: Tibetan bowl struck #4
2555.recording: Studio; Sound Devices MixPre-3 and Sennheiser ME66
2555.selection: Retained comparison, not selected: strongest measured mode near 2.4 kHz, more early energy than #2. Selection is analytical, pending listening.

gong-4.title: Gong ("gong-4")
gong-4.format: MP3, 320 kbps, 44.1 kHz stereo (near-mono: left/right correlation 0.9996); 9.46 s
gong-4.rightsReview: Supplied by the owner in chat as the new interval bell, without its original source or licence. Record both here and confirm commercial redistribution without attribution or fees before a public release.
gong-4.selection: Interval since 2026-10-15 at the owner's request: approximately 439 Hz fundamental with its octave, natural decay of about 8 dB per second to silence within 9 s. Mastered lightly: a short pre-strike trim, a 30 ms fade into the strike and a gentle -3 dB shelf above 2 kHz; same quiet interval level as before.
